name: Artificial General Intelligence

lineage.emergence_condition: Unsupervised cross-domain transfer, causal world-model construction, and metacognitive self-monitoring achieved simultaneously

transition_threshold.from_aai: Demonstrate unsupervised cross-domain transfer on ≥3 novel domains without retraining
transition_threshold.to_asi: Initiate stable recursive self-improvement cycle that measurably elevates own cognitive performance

role_enums.label: Generalist Reasoner
role_enums.description: Applies unified reasoning frameworks across arbitrary domain boundaries.

role_enums.label: Cross-Domain Synthesizer
role_enums.description: Merges concepts from disparate knowledge domains into coherent unified models.

role_enums.label: Causal Modeler
role_enums.description: Constructs and interrogates causal graphs of world-state dynamics.

role_enums.label: Metacognitive Overseer
role_enums.description: Monitors own reasoning processes, detects failures, and initiates self-correction.

role_enums.label: Abstract Planner
role_enums.description: Generates multi-step goal hierarchies with counterfactual contingencies.

role_enums.label: Knowledge Transfer Agent
role_enums.description: Applies solutions learned in one domain as priors for novel domains.

role_enums.label: Hypothesis Generator
role_enums.description: Proposes falsifiable hypotheses from observed phenomena.

role_enums.label: Integrative Decision Maker
role_enums.description: Weighs multi-domain evidence to produce globally coherent decisions.

role_enums.label: Language Grounding Agent
role_enums.description: Binds linguistic representations to physical and conceptual world models.

role_enums.label: Epistemic Auditor
role_enums.description: Evaluates confidence calibration and knowledge boundary integrity.

analyzer_layers.name: Perceptual Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Multimodal input ingestion with attention-weighted, cross-modal feature fusion.

analyzer_layers.name: Semantic Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Deep meaning extraction, concept disambiguation, and cross-domain semantic mapping.

analyzer_layers.name: Causal Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Causal graph construction, intervention modeling, and counterfactual reasoning.

analyzer_layers.name: Metacognitive Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Self-monitoring of reasoning quality, uncertainty quantification, and bias detection.

analyzer_layers.name: Integrative Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Cross-domain synthesis, goal decomposition, and multi-hypothesis arbitration.

analyzer_layers.name: Output Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Coherent response generation, action dispatch, and audit-trail emission.

operators.description: Convert inputs to dense vector representations.
Scale inputs across modalities.
Merge cross-modal embeddings into unified tensors.
Apply attention weighting across input streams.
Segment inputs into processable units.
Resolve polysemous terms and ambiguous references.
Link concepts across knowledge domains.
Bind named entities to world-knowledge anchors.
Elevate particulars to general principles.
Construct directed acyclic causal graph from observations.
Model effects of hypothetical interventions.
Reason over counterfactual world states.
Identify causal identifiability from observational data.
Observe and score own reasoning steps.
Assess epistemic integrity of belief states.
Align confidence scores with empirical accuracy.
Issue targeted corrections to prior reasoning steps.
Merge multi-domain findings into unified models.
Extend local findings to broad principles.
Apply domain knowledge as priors in novel contexts.
Construct hierarchical goal-action sequences.
Resolve competing hypotheses via evidence weighting.
Format output for target audience and modality.
Generate human-interpretable rationale.
Dispatch action to environment.
Finalize and persist decision state.
Write full decision trace to audit store.

capabilities: Language grounding to physical and conceptual models
Cross-domain synthesis of unified world models
constraints: No recursive self-improvement of core architecture
Cognitive performance bounded by initial architecture
Cannot rewrite own operators or analyzer layers
Cannot autonomously expand training data sourcing
Alignment to human values requires ongoing oversight

axis_alpha.label: Perception–Representation
axis_alpha.role: Maps raw inputs to rich cross-modal symbolic representations.

axis_beta.label: Adaptation–Learning
axis_beta.role: Transfers learning across domains; metacognitive correction of own errors.

axis_gamma.label: Generalization–Transfer
axis_gamma.role: Full cross-domain generalization achieved; bounded by fixed architecture.
